# Cornelius’ Prayer (Acts 10:4)

## Emotional Focus
God hears the prayers of people who want to know Him.

## Key KJV
“Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.” (Acts 10:4)

## Gentle Retelling
Cornelius prayed every day even though he didn’t know everything about Jesus yet. God heard him and sent Peter to tell him the good news.

## Coloring Prompt
Cornelius kneeling peacefully in his home while an angel appears.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God hears every honest prayer from your heart.”
